title: Northwind × Fjord Logistics: discovery call
attendees: Maya Okafor <maya@northwind.example>, Lars Eide <lars.eide@fjordlogistics.example>, Ingrid Solberg <ingrid@fjordlogistics.example>
transcript:
Maya: Thanks for making time, Lars, Ingrid. Last time you mentioned the warehouse in Bergen is where the picking errors hurt most?
Lars: Right. We're at about 3% mis-picks there. Each one costs us a return and an angry customer. We want that under 1% by the summer peak.
Maya: And today that's all handheld scanners?
Ingrid: Handhelds plus paper for the bulky items. That paper part is the problem.
Maya: That's exactly where our pick-to-light carts help. How many pickers per shift in Bergen?
Lars: Around forty. If it works there we'd look at Stavanger and Trondheim next year.
Maya: Got it. On budget, do you have a range for a pilot?
Lars: We've set aside roughly 600,000 kroner for this year. Anything above that needs our CFO, Henrik Dahl.
Maya: Makes sense. Is Henrik usually involved early or only at sign-off?
Lars: Honestly, it's better to get him in early. He'll ask about payback.
Maya: Then I'll put together a payback model for Henrik based on your 3% error rate and forty pickers. I can have that to you by Friday.
Ingrid: One concern from my side. Our WMS is Manhattan. Last vendor said they integrate and then it took six months.
Maya: Fair. I'll send you our Manhattan integration case study and connect you with our solutions engineer, Tomás, for a technical call next week.
Ingrid: Good. Tuesday or Wednesday works for me.
Lars: Also, Autostore came in last month with a much bigger proposal. We're comparing.
Maya: Understood. I'll include a side-by-side in the proposal, focused on what a forty-picker pilot costs versus a full automation project.
Lars: Perfect. If Henrik is happy with the numbers, we could start a pilot in January.
Maya: Great. So: payback model by Friday, technical call with Tomás Tuesday or Wednesday, then a proposal with the comparison. I'll also update our notes on the timeline.
Lars: Sounds right.
